title.original: Cayley Graph Optimization for Scalable Multi-Agent Communication Topologies
title.zh: 用于可扩展多智能体通信拓扑的Cayley图优化
title.en: Cayley Graph Optimization for Scalable Multi-Agent Communication Topologies

inclusion_reason.zh: CayleyTopo 将稀疏通信图的搜索和故障评估自动化，形成可复用的多 Agent 网络拓扑设计组件。
inclusion_reason.en: CayleyTopo automates sparse communication-graph search and failure evaluation as a reusable network-topology design component for multi-agent systems.

abstract.zh: CayleyTopo 把多 Agent 通信图本身作为可优化变量，以低直径循环 Cayley 图替代全连接或手工稀疏拓扑。
abstract.en: CayleyTopo treats the multi-agent communication graph as an optimization variable, replacing all-to-all or hand-crafted sparse networks with low-diameter circulant Cayley graphs.

problem.zh: 全连接通信随 Agent 数量呈二次增长，而既有稀疏图依赖人工规则，无法系统优化最坏情况下的信息传播速度与韧性。
problem.en: All-to-all communication grows quadratically, while hand-designed sparse graphs do not systematically optimize worst-case information propagation and resilience.

approach.zh: 轻量 RL 搜索 Cayley 生成元集合，以数论先验偏向结构良好的候选，并用消息传播分数提供稠密构图反馈。
approach.en: Lightweight RL searches Cayley generator sets, guided by a number-theoretic prior and a dense message-propagation score during graph construction.

system_design.zh: 拓扑生成器输出循环图，评估器计算直径、负载与断链传播，RL 策略据此迭代生成元，最终图供 Agent 通信层部署。
system_design.en: A topology generator proposes circulant graphs, an evaluator measures diameter, load, and failure propagation, and an RL policy iterates generators before deployment.

key_results.zh: 优化图比手工稀疏拓扑传播更快、通信负载更低且更耐链路故障，并接近理论 Moore 界。
key_results.en: Optimized graphs disseminate information faster, carry less communication load, and tolerate link failures better than hand-crafted sparse topologies while approaching the Moore bound.

limitations.zh: 图指标把消息视为同质信号，尚未反映语义压缩、异步延迟、Agent 能力差异和拥塞对真实协作质量的影响。
limitations.en: Graph metrics treat messages as homogeneous and do not yet capture semantic compression, asynchronous latency, heterogeneous agents, or congestion effects on real collaboration.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
